description: This PHP file defines LoginController class in the OrangeHRM application, managing login view rendering, integrating CSRF tokens, social media login providers, and handling user authentication state.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling user login view, integrating social media authentication, CSRF protection, and redirection based on authentication state.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HomePageService instance used for determining the homepage path.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and props for the login component, including error messages, CSRF tokens, branding images, social media providers, and demo mode indicator.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming request; if the user is already authenticated, redirects to the homepage, otherwise proceeds with default handling.

methods.name: getProvidersList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of configured social media authentication providers for display on the login page.
